acceptance.minimum_persistence: All 19 intended roles survive two consecutive scheduled invocation boundaries with later repo-first live readback and durable role-valid progress evidence.
acceptance.canary_success: multi_agent remains enabled after the next slot; semantic-entry credit additionally requires an applicable config8 pre-semantic witness. Continue to terminal witness plus second full-pool boundary.
acceptance.canary_failure: multi_agent stops again, earliest witness remains absent, misses intended slot, crosses CLEAN/authority boundaries, or materially regresses useful output. Failure advances diagnosis but never reduces the pool or closes Phase 1.

fallback_and_switching.if_any_role_stops_again: Capture current live state and exact role receipt/config where available, then re-enable the same stopped enabled_desired task immediately. Never reduce the denominator.
fallback_and_switching.if_active_canary_fails: Preserve live-state and witness absence/presence, re-enable same task if stopped, and switch away from prompt-only return-path hardening to another zero-cost Chat-visible same-task early-lifecycle alternative.
fallback_and_switching.if_active_canary_survives: Continue until the required second full-pool survived boundary before treating scheduler persistence as passed.

rollback_metadata.previous_multi_agent_bootstrap_prompt: BOOTSTRAP-ONLY role=multi_agent. Every invocation first read note/automation_control/DESIRED_STATE.json and then note/automation_control/roles/multi_agent.json using the repository authority/freshness procedure defined there; execute only the current repository role config. Repository control is authoritative for all substantive behavior. While enabled_desired=true, this recurring task is not globally complete at an invocation boundary: never disable, pause, delete, replace, or reschedule this automation and never call scheduler mutation as a completion action. Preserve the CLEAN boundary before semantic work; do not read or write the shared aggregate execution ledger unless the current repository role config explicitly permits it. End only the current invocation according to the role config, persist only role-authorized durable evidence/continuation when possible, and leave the scheduler enabled.
